sources: https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/blob/v5.4/components/soc/esp32c2/include/soc/soc_caps.h (SOC_UART_NUM 2, SOC_I2C_NUM 1, SOC_SPI_PERIPH_NUM 2 with only SPI2 reachable from the GPIO matrix, SOC_LEDC_CHANNEL_NUM 6, SOC_ADC_PERIPH_NUM 1 with 5 channels, SOC_GPIO_PIN_COUNT 21; no SOC_RMT_SUPPORTED, SOC_I2S_SUPPORTED, SOC_TWAI_SUPPORTED, USB or LCD/SDMMC caps, so this chip has no RMT, I2S, TWAI, USB, LCD_CAM or SD host controller)

https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/blob/v5.4/components/soc/esp32c2/include/soc/adc_channel.h (ADC1 GPIO0-4 = CH0-4; the file also carries a legacy ADC2 GPIO5 entry, but SOC_ADC_PERIPH_NUM is 1 and the GPIO docs leave GPIO5 without an analog function, so ADC2 is not modeled)

https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/v5.4/esp32c2/api-reference/peripherals/gpio.html (GPIO11-17 are dedicated to the SiP flash on variants with in-package flash, leaving 14 usable GPIOs; GPIO8/GPIO9 are strapping pins)
scope: Standard UART, HP I2C, standard SPI master (plus the optional quad-mode WP = IO2 / HD = IO3 lines), LEDC channels and ADC1 only; the ESP32-C2 has no RMT, I2S, TWAI (CAN), USB Serial/JTAG, LCD_CAM or SDMMC host controller, so none of those are modeled. SPI0/1 belong to the flash controller, so only SPI2 is offered as a GP-SPI on the GPIO matrix. ADC1 is the only ADC unit (SOC_ADC_PERIPH_NUM 1) with five channels on GPIO0-4; the ADC2 entry that still exists in the soc adc_channel.h header is not modeled because the unit count and the GPIO docs do not expose a second unit. GPIO19/GPIO20 default to U0RXD/U0TXD.
